footer.companyDescription: CV. Tri Jaya Utama is dedicated to providing superior light steel truss solutions with high engineering standards for a safer Indonesia.

industrial.title: Industrial & Commercial
industrial.description: We understand rigorous industrial standards. For factories, warehouses, and commercial facilities, TJU delivers roof truss systems engineered to heavy-duty standards with unrivaled software calculation precision.

residential.title: Residential
residential.description: The roof of a home protects the entire family. We guarantee neat, structured, and officially warrantied installation. TJU Truss provides absolute peace of mind for homeowners prioritizing quality over low-cost compromises.

history.title: From Initiative to Industrial Solution
history.description: CV. Tri Jaya Utama was established in 2000 to answer the challenge of wood scarcity. We transformed from an applicator into an independent manufacturer to ensure absolute quality control.

m2000.description: Introducing light steel solutions to the local market through residential development networks.

m2001.description: Establishment of CV Tri Jaya Utama. The birth of TJU TRUSS as an authorized applicator and distributor.

m2010.description: Self-Manufacturing Era. TJU TRUSS began self-production with official SNI & HAKI certifications.

now.description: 25+ Years of Excellence, becoming a trusted partner for residential and industrial projects.

coreValues.title: Core Values
coreValues.description: CV. Tri Jaya Utama utilizes software that has been verified by HAKI and certified fit for use.
